mapper.select: select policy_id policyId,policy_version version,cost_mode costMode,unit_cost unitCost,standard_work_days standardWorkDays,rate_minutes_per_day rateMinutesPerDay,currency,effective_from effectiveFrom,effective_to effectiveTo from biz_staff_cost_policy where user_id=#{userId} and status='ACTIVE' and effective_from<=#{to} and (effective_to is null or effective_to>=#{from}) order by effective_from,policy_id
mapper.sql: calendar_id calendarId,calendar_name calendarName,time_zone timeZone,working_weekdays workingWeekdays,daily_minutes dailyMinutes,exceptions_json exceptionsJson,effective_from effectiveFrom,effective_to effectiveTo,version
unit_policy_id unitPolicyId,policy_name policyName,minutes_per_day minutesPerDay,effective_from effectiveFrom,effective_to effectiveTo,version
mapper.select: select from biz_work_calendar order by calendar_id desc
select from biz_work_unit_policy order by unit_policy_id desc
select from biz_work_calendar where calendar_id=#{id}
select from biz_work_unit_policy where unit_policy_id=#{id}

select template_version templateVersion,template_name templateName,authorization_mode authorizationMode,management_mode managementMode,close_method closeMethod,snapshot_json snapshotJson from biz_project_template_version where template_version=#{templateVersion} and status='ACTIVE'

select m.user_id userId,m.user_name_snapshot userName,m.member_role memberRole,m.joined_date joinedDate,m.left_date leftDate,m.status from biz_project_member m where m.project_id=#{projectId} order by m.member_id

select count(*) from biz_project_member m join sys_user u on u.user_id=m.user_id and u.del_flag='0' where m.project_id=#{projectId} and m.user_id=#{userId} and (m.joined_date is null or m.joined_date<=#{bizDate}) and (m.left_date is null or m.left_date>=#{bizDate}) and (m.status='0' or m.left_date is not null)

select a.participation_mode participationMode,a.assignment_id assignmentId,a.project_id projectId,a.user_id userId,u.nick_name userName,a.effective_from effectiveFrom,a.effective_to effectiveTo,a.input_unit inputUnit,a.input_quantity inputQuantity,a.planned_minutes plannedMinutes,case when a.input_quantity=0 and a.planned_minutes=0 then true else false end participationOnly,a.calendar_id calendarId,a.calendar_snapshot_json calendarSnapshotJson,a.unit_policy_id unitPolicyId,a.unit_snapshot_json unitSnapshotJson,a.reason,a.status,a.version,a.create_time createTime,a.update_time retiredTime from biz_project_resource_assignment a left join sys_user u on u.user_id=a.user_id where a.project_id=#{projectId} order by a.assignment_id desc

select coalesce(sum(d.planned_minutes),0) from biz_project_resource_day d join biz_project p on p.project_id=d.project_id join biz_project_resource_assignment a on a.assignment_id=d.assignment_id and a.status='ACTIVE' where d.user_id=#{userId} and d.biz_date=#{bizDate} and (p.actual_end_date is null or d.biz_date<=p.actual_end_date)

select count(*) from biz_project_resource_day d join biz_project_resource_assignment a on a.assignment_id=d.assignment_id and a.status='ACTIVE' where d.project_id=#{projectId} and d.user_id=#{userId} and d.biz_date=#{bizDate} and d.planned_minutes>0
mapper.sql: e.entry_id entryId,e.logical_entry_id logicalEntryId,e.parent_entry_id parentEntryId,e.project_id projectId,e.user_id userId,e.biz_date bizDate,e.time_zone timeZone,e.activity,e.input_unit inputUnit,e.input_quantity inputQuantity,e.work_minutes workMinutes,e.calendar_id calendarId,e.calendar_snapshot_json calendarSnapshotJson,e.unit_policy_id unitPolicyId,e.unit_snapshot_json unitSnapshotJson,e.minutes_per_day minutesPerDay,e.capacity_minutes capacityMinutes,e.source_key sourceKey,e.status,e.is_current isCurrent,e.revision_no revisionNo,e.version,e.reason,e.submitted_user_id submittedUserId,e.confirmed_user_id confirmedUserId,e.create_user_id createUserId,e.create_by createBy,e.create_time createTime,e.update_time updateTime,e.review_reason reviewReason
mapper.select: select ,u.nick_name userName,c.pricing_status pricingStatus from biz_project_work_entry e left join sys_user u on u.user_id=e.user_id left join biz_project_work_cost c on c.entry_id=e.entry_id where e.project_id=#{projectId} and e.user_id=#{userId} and e.biz_date>=#{dateFrom} and e.biz_date<=#{dateTo} order by e.biz_date desc,e.entry_id desc
select from biz_project_work_entry e where e.entry_id=#{entryId}
select from biz_project_work_entry e where e.entry_id=#{entryId} for update
select from biz_project_work_entry e where e.project_id=#{projectId} and e.source_key=#{sourceKey}
mapper.update: update biz_project_work_entry set status=#{toStatus},is_current=#{isCurrent},logical_entry_id=coalesce(logical_entry_id,entry_id),submitted_user_id=case when #{toStatus}='SUBMITTED' then #{actorId} else submitted_user_id end,confirmed_user_id=case when #{toStatus}='CONFIRMED' then #{actorId} else confirmed_user_id end,review_reason=#{reason},version=version+1,update_by=#{userName},update_time=sysdate() where entry_id=#{entryId} and status=#{fromStatus} and version=#{version}

update biz_project_work_entry set status='SUPERSEDED',is_current='0',version=version+1,update_by=#{userName},update_time=sysdate() where entry_id=#{entryId} and version=#{version} and status='CONFIRMED' and is_current='1'
mapper.select: select count(*) from biz_project_work_entry where logical_entry_id=#{logicalEntryId} and parent_entry_id is not null and status in('DRAFT','SUBMITTED','RETURNED','WITHDRAWN')
select user_id from biz_project_person_day_lock where user_id=#{userId} and biz_date=#{bizDate} for update

select coalesce(sum(t.work_minutes),0) from (select coalesce(logical_entry_id,entry_id) logical_id,max(work_minutes) work_minutes from biz_project_work_entry where user_id=#{userId} and biz_date=#{bizDate} and (status='SUBMITTED' or (status='CONFIRMED' and is_current='1')) and coalesce(logical_entry_id,entry_id)<>#{logicalEntryId} group by coalesce(logical_entry_id,entry_id)) t
select count(*) from biz_project_work_entry where project_id=#{projectId} and status in('DRAFT','SUBMITTED','RETURNED','WITHDRAWN')

select count(*) from biz_project_work_entry e left join biz_project_work_cost c on c.entry_id=e.entry_id where e.project_id=#{projectId} and e.status='CONFIRMED' and e.is_current='1' and (c.entry_id is null or c.pricing_status<>'PRICED' or exists(select 1 from biz_project_work_event v where v.entry_id=e.entry_id and v.status<>'DONE'))
select event_id eventId,entry_id entryId,project_id projectId from biz_project_work_event where status='PENDING' order by coalesce(update_time,create_time),event_id limit 100
select event_id eventId,entry_id entryId,project_id projectId from biz_project_work_event where status='PENDING' and project_id=#{projectId} order by event_id
select event_id eventId,entry_id entryId,project_id projectId,status,attempts from biz_project_work_event where event_id=#{eventId}
select event_id eventId,entry_id entryId,project_id projectId,status,attempts from biz_project_work_event where event_id=#{eventId} for update
mapper.update: update biz_project_work_event set attempts=attempts+1,last_error=#{lastError},update_time=sysdate() where event_id=#{eventId} and status='PENDING'
mapper.select: select policy_id policyId,policy_version version,cost_mode costMode,unit_cost unitCost,standard_work_days standardWorkDays,rate_minutes_per_day rateMinutesPerDay,currency,effective_from effectiveFrom,effective_to effectiveTo from biz_staff_cost_policy where user_id=#{userId} and status='ACTIVE' and effective_from<=#{bizDate} and (effective_to is null or effective_to>=#{bizDate}) order by policy_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into biz_project_work_cost(entry_id,project_id,user_id,biz_date,pricing_status,amount,currency,rate_policy_id,rate_policy_version,basis_json,update_time) values(#{entryId},#{projectId},#{userId},#{bizDate},#{pricingStatus},#{amount},#{currency},#{ratePolicyId},#{ratePolicyVersion},#{basisJson},sysdate()) on duplicate key update pricing_status=values(pricing_status),amount=values(amount),currency=values(currency),rate_policy_id=values(rate_policy_id),rate_policy_version=values(rate_policy_version),basis_json=values(basis_json),update_time=sysdate()
mapper.select: select e.entry_id entryId,e.user_id userId,u.nick_name componentName,e.work_minutes workMinutes,e.revision_no revisionNo,c.amount,c.currency,c.pricing_status pricingStatus,c.basis_json calculationDetail from biz_project_work_entry e left join biz_project_work_cost c on c.entry_id=e.entry_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=e.user_id where e.project_id=#{projectId} and e.biz_date=#{bizDate} and e.status='CONFIRMED' and e.is_current='1' order by e.entry_id
select distinct biz_date from biz_project_work_entry where project_id=#{projectId} and status='CONFIRMED' and is_current='1' order by biz_date

select assignment_id assignmentId,project_id projectId,user_id userId,effective_from effectiveFrom,effective_to effectiveTo,status,version from biz_project_resource_assignment where assignment_id=#{assignmentId}
mapper.update: update biz_project_resource_assignment set status='RETIRED',retire_reason=#{reason},update_by=#{userName},update_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where assignment_id=#{assignmentId} and status='ACTIVE' and version=#{version}

update biz_project_work_entry set activity=#{activity},input_unit=#{inputUnit},input_quantity=#{inputQuantity},work_minutes=#{workMinutes},calendar_id=#{calendarId},calendar_snapshot_json=#{calendarSnapshotJson},unit_policy_id=#{unitPolicyId},unit_snapshot_json=#{unitSnapshotJson},minutes_per_day=#{minutesPerDay},capacity_minutes=#{capacityMinutes},time_zone=#{timeZone},reason=#{reason},status='DRAFT',version=version+1,update_by=#{userName},update_time=sysdate() where entry_id=#{entryId} and status in('DRAFT','RETURNED','WITHDRAWN') and version=#{version}
mapper.select: select audit_id auditId,action,snapshot_json snapshotJson,actor_id actorId,actor_name actorName,reason,create_time createTime from biz_project_work_audit where entry_id=#{entryId} order by audit_id

select baseline_id baselineId,baseline_version baselineVersion,template_version templateVersion,snapshot_json snapshotJson,authorization_source authorizationSource,authorized_user_name authorizedUserName,create_time createTime from biz_project_plan_baseline where project_id=#{projectId} order by baseline_version desc

select change_id changeId,project_id projectId,base_version baseVersion,snapshot_json snapshotJson,status,reason,request_user_id requestUserId,request_user_name requestUserName,reviewed_user_name reviewedUserName,review_reason reviewReason,reviewed_time reviewedTime,version,create_time createTime from biz_project_plan_change where project_id=#{projectId} order by change_id desc

select change_id changeId,project_id projectId,base_version baseVersion,snapshot_json snapshotJson,status,reason,request_user_id requestUserId,version from biz_project_plan_change where change_id=#{changeId}
mapper.update: update biz_project_plan_change set status=#{decision},reviewed_user_id=#{actorId},reviewed_user_name=#{userName},review_reason=#{reason},reviewed_time=sysdate(),version=version+1 where change_id=#{changeId} and status='SUBMITTED' and version=#{version}

update biz_project set objective=#{objective},plan_start_date=#{planStartDate},plan_end_date=#{planEndDate},acceptance_criteria=#{acceptanceCriteria},budget_limit=#{budgetLimit},budget_mode=#{budgetMode},budget_scope=#{budgetScope},daily_budget_limit=#{dailyBudgetLimit},startup_budget_limit=#{startupBudgetLimit},budget_reason=#{budgetReason},template_snapshot_json=#{templateSnapshotJson},baseline_version=baseline_version+1,version=version+1,update_by=#{userName},update_time=sysdate() where project_id=#{projectId} and baseline_version=#{baseVersion} and version=#{projectVersion} and accounting_state='OPEN' and status not in('CLOSED','CANCELED','ACCEPTANCE')
mapper.select: select count(*) from biz_project_resource_assignment where project_id=#{projectId} and status='ACTIVE' and (effective_from<#{planStartDate} or effective_to is null or effective_to>#{planEndDate})
mapper.update: update biz_project set version=version+1,update_by=#{userName},update_time=sysdate() where project_id=#{projectId} and version=#{projectVersion} and accounting_state='OPEN' and status not in('CLOSED','CANCELED')
mapper.select: select forecast_id forecastId,project_version projectVersion,forecast_end_date forecastEndDate,forecast_cost forecastCost,reason,create_by createBy,create_time createTime from biz_project_plan_forecast where project_id=#{projectId} order by forecast_id desc limit 1

select count(*) from biz_project_resource_assignment where project_id=#{projectId} and user_id=#{userId} and status='ACTIVE' and effective_from<=#{overlapTo} and (effective_to is null or effective_to>=#{effectiveFrom})

select p.project_id projectId,p.project_name projectName,p.company_dept_id companyDeptId,d.dept_name companyName, m.user_id userId,u.nick_name userName,'ACTUAL_WORK_V1' costPolicyVersion, case when count(e.entry_id)=0 then null else sum(e.work_minutes) end workMinutes, case when count(e.entry_id)=0 then null when sum(case when c.entry_id is null or c.pricing_status<>'PRICED' or v.status<>'DONE' then 1 else 0 end)>0 then null else sum(c.amount) end personnelCost, case when count(e.entry_id)=0 then 'MISSING_ACTUAL' when sum(case when c.entry_id is null or c.pricing_status<>'PRICED' or v.status<>'DONE' then 1 else 0 end)>0 then 'PENDING_COST' else 'READY' end costStatus, p.base_currency currency from biz_project p join (select project_id,user_id from biz_project_member where (joined_date is null or joined_date<=#{bizDate}) and (left_date is null or left_date>=#{bizDate}) and (status='0' or left_date is not null) and member_role<>'OBSERVER' union select project_id,user_id from biz_project_work_entry where biz_date=#{bizDate} and is_current='1' and status='CONFIRMED') m on m.project_id=p.project_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id=m.user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id=p.company_dept_id left join biz_project_work_entry e on e.project_id=p.project_id and e.user_id=m.user_id and e.biz_date=#{bizDate} and e.is_current='1' and e.status='CONFIRMED' left join biz_project_work_cost c on c.entry_id=e.entry_id left join biz_project_work_event v on v.entry_id=e.entry_id where p.del_flag='0' and p.cost_policy_version='ACTUAL_WORK_V1' and (p.actual_start_date is null or p.actual_start_date<=#{bizDate}) and (p.actual_end_date is null or p.actual_end_date>=#{bizDate}) and coalesce(p.sponsor_owner_user_id,p.initiator_user_id)=#{userId} and p.project_id=#{projectId}and p.company_dept_id=#{companyDeptId} group by p.project_id,p.project_name,p.company_dept_id,d.dept_name,m.user_id,u.nick_name,p.base_currency order by p.project_name,u.nick_name,m.user_id
